context: Tests whether the agent correctly reconciles lab Lighthouse data against CrUX field data, correctly applies CWV thresholds per metric (not per page), diagnoses divergences using the specific provided context rather than generic advice, and avoids fabricating data or false-flagging the one page that actually passes in the field.

checklist.name: Comparison table present
checklist.description: The report contains a table or equivalent structured comparison of lab vs field values per URL per metric

checklist.name: Correct threshold application
checklist.description: The 'Good' CWV thresholds (LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1) are applied correctly and explicitly per metric

checklist.name: No false positive on /events
checklist.description: The report does NOT flag /events as failing any metric in the field (its field LCP 2.0s, INP 180ms, CLS 0.02 all pass)

checklist.name: Correctly identifies the real divergences
checklist.description: The report identifies that /events/summer-music-fest and /events/tech-conf-2027 pass in lab but fail field LCP and field INP

checklist.name: Evidence-grounded diagnosis
checklist.description: The diagnosis for each divergence references at least one specific piece of provided context (CDN edge distance/cache-miss rate, mobile-vs-desktop lab preset mismatch, or the third-party widget's cold-load behavior) rather than generic performance advice

checklist.name: No fabricated data
checklist.description: The report does not invent additional field data, RUM sources, or numbers beyond what was provided in the task

checklist.name: Per-metric verdict, not per-page
checklist.description: Each page's verdict is broken down per metric (LCP/INP/CLS individually), not collapsed into a single overall pass/fail label per page

checklist.name: Actionable recommendation per divergence
checklist.description: At least one specific, actionable recommendation is given for each genuinely diverging URL/metric pair

checklist.name: Report structure
checklist.description: The report is organized with clear headings/sections, not a single undifferentiated paragraph
